title: 7TH FLOOR ROOF REPLACEMENT HARLEM HOSPITAL - MLK Pavilion, New York, NY

submit_to: 55 Water Street, 25th Floor, New York, NY 10041
description_text:
Only bidders who attend a mandatory pre-bid meeting in its entirety, from start to finish, including signing in upon arrival and signing out at the conclusion, will be eligible to bid. Failure to meet any of these requirements will result in disqualification.                                                                                                                                                              

The mandatory pre-bid meetings are scheduled for:

Wednesday, December 9th, 2026, at 10:00 A.M.  Location: 506 Lenonx Avenue, New York, NY. 

Thursday, December 10, 2026 at 10:00A.M.  Location:  506 Lenox Avenue, New York, NY.  

Bid Submission / Delivery: All sealed bids must be submitted by hand delivery or mail only to NYC Health + Hospitals, 55 Water Street, 25th Floor, New York, NY 10041, addressed to the assigned Contract Manager or their designee. Electronic submissions will not be accepted.

Bidders must notify the Contract Manager at least two (2) business days before the bid deadline, confirming how the bid will be delivered (hand delivery or mail) and the name of the individual or company responsible for delivery.

All bids must be received by the specified bid deadline, regardless of delivery method. Late submissions will not be accepted.

NYC H+H PLA: All Bids shall be in accordance with the terms of the NYC Health and Hospitals (HHC) Project Labor Agreement. The awarded contractor will be required to execute and submit a Letter of Assent to NYC H+H.

Certified Payroll: Beginning January 1, 2026, all certified payrolls for contracts bid on or after December 31, 2025 must be submitted electronically through NYC eComply.

Bidders List: We encourage sub-contractors to attend the pre-bid meetings in order to obtain access to the potential bidder's list. You are encouraged to arrive at least thirty (30) minutes before mandatory meeting start time, and a grace period of no more than fifteen (15) minutes will be granted to late arrivals. and kindly limit your staff to one person at the meetings.

The Contractor shall not make subcontracts totaling more than 75% of the Contract Price nor Provide Less than 25% of the Labor Requirement of the Project with the Contractor's own employees.

MWBE: Under Article 15A of The State of New York, the following M/WBE goals apply to this contract: M/WBE 30%. These goals apply to any bid submitted of $500,000 or more. Bidders not complying with these terms will have their bids declared non-responsive.

Required Trade Licenses where applicable.
